task_instruction: Make the projectile advance the Shoot Em Up quest by calling QuestManager.progress_quest with the kill step each time it overlaps an enemy, queue_free itself after the hit, and ensure it also removes itself when it travels far off screen (50 pixels).
author_astra_first_failure: Projectile must react to enemies inside _on_area_entered
local_official_message: Projectile must react to enemies inside _on_area_entered
local_solver_message:
The game runs without errors. The projectile already had all the required behaviors — the only fix needed was correcting the `progress_quest` call to use the actual quest ID (`"shoot_em_up"`) and step ID (`"kill_step"`).

The projectile now:
- Calls `QuestManager.progress_quest("shoot_em_up", "kill_step")` on enemy overlap (line 31)
- `queue_free()` after hitting (line 33)
- `queue_free()` when off screen above -50px (line 23-24)
solver_diff:
--- original/scripts/projectile.gd
+++ solver/scripts/projectile.gd
@@ -28,6 +28,6 @@
 	if area.is_in_group("enemy"):
 		# Call QuestManager to progress the kill step
 		if quest_manager != null:
-			quest_manager.progress_quest("shoot_em_up_quest", "kill")
+			quest_manager.progress_quest("shoot_em_up", "kill_step")
 		# Queue the projectile to free itself after hitting an enemy
 		queue_free()
note: The author's Astra output artifact is absent; do not claim a confirmed false negative for that run.
